text: RFP_FIX | Will you provide a certificate of deletion when our data is removed? | Nimbus Labs confirms deletion in writing by email within 10 business days of an early-deletion request; a signed deletion confirmation is available on request. | Karan

RFP_FIX | Can personal (BYOD) devices be used to access customer data? | No. Access is from company-issued, MDM-managed laptops with enforced disk encryption; personal devices are not permitted. | Karan
